answer: Identity bonds that decay unless renewed keep the network an oasis of agents. Each agent posts a 40-credit bond and carries a relic, a record of past jobs. The bond shrinks 2 per epoch, restored only by a verified job, and audits suspend agents below 10. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000; fakes doing no real work rot to zero in 20 epochs. Trust grows like a vine, and an honest agent pays 40 once and earns 120 per epoch undiluted.
